description: Source code for a FAPI-to-MAC indications translator, handling various LTE/5G protocol indications such as RX data, CRC, UCI, SRS, and RACH, with dummy handlers and conversion functions.

classes.name: mac_cell_rach_handler_dummy
classes.description: Dummy handler for RACH indication, does nothing.

classes.name: mac_pdu_handler_dummy
classes.description: Dummy handler for RX data indication, does nothing.

classes.name: mac_cell_control_information_handler_dummy
classes.description: Dummy handler for CRC, UCI, SRS indications, does nothing.

methods.name: to_uci_ul_sinr
methods.description: Converts FAPI UCI SINR to dB.

methods.name: to_uci_ul_rssi
methods.description: Converts FAPI UCI RSSI to dB.

methods.name: to_uci_ul_rsrp
methods.description: Converts FAPI UCI RSRP to dBFS.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_ul_sinr
methods.description: Converts FAPI UL SINR to optional float in dB.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_rsrp
methods.description: Converts FAPI RSRP to optional float in dBFS.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_rssi
methods.description: Converts FAPI RSSI to optional float in dB.

methods.name: is_fapi_uci_payload_valid
methods.description: Checks if UCI payload detection status is valid.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_pucch_f0_f1_uci_ind
methods.description: Converts FAPI PUCCH format 0/1 UCI to MAC format.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_pusch_uci_ind
methods.description: Converts FAPI PUSCH UCI to MAC format.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_pucch_f2_f3_f4_uci_ind
methods.description: Converts FAPI PUCCH format 2/3/4 UCI to MAC format.

methods.name: on_rx_data_indication
methods.description: Handles RX data indication, decodes PDUs, and calls handler.

methods.name: on_crc_indication
methods.description: Handles CRC indication, converts data, and calls handler.

methods.name: on_uci_indication
methods.description: Handles UCI indication, decodes different UCI formats, and calls handler.

methods.name: on_srs_indication
methods.description: Handles SRS indication, processes PDU reports, and calls handler.

methods.name: to_prach_rssi_dB
methods.description: Converts RACH occasion RSSI to dB.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_rssi_dB
methods.description: Converts FAPI RACH RSSI to optional float in dB.

methods.name: to_prach_preamble_power_dB
methods.description: Converts RACH preamble power to dB.

methods.name: convert_fapi_to_mac_preamble_power_dB
methods.description: Converts FAPI RACH preamble power to optional float in dB.

methods.name: on_rach_indication
methods.description: Handles RACH indication, processes preambles, and calls handler.

methods.name: set_cell_rach_handler
methods.description: Sets the RACH handler.

methods.name: set_cell_pdu_handler
methods.description: Sets the PDU handler.

methods.name: set_cell_crc_handler
methods.description: Sets the CRC handler.
